title: The rules of Wudu – the four fard
intro: Four things must be done in wudu – without them wudu is not right.

learn.html: The four things we must do in wudu are called the conditions or fard of wudu. Without them, wudu is not right.

items.label: 2. Wash the right and left arm past the elbows once
3. Wipe at least a quarter of the head with a wet hand – mash
4. Wash the right and left foot past the ankles once

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah says: O believers, when you stand up to pray, wash your faces and your arms up to the elbows, wipe over your heads, and wash your feet up to the ankles… <small>(Qur’an, Al-Ma’idah 5:6)</small>

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: In wudu we wash these parts three times – but the fard is to wash them at least once.

practice.title: The four fard of wudu
practice.prompt: Tap the four fard of wudu, then tap Check.

options.text: Washing the arms past the elbows
Wiping a quarter of the head
Washing the feet past the ankles

options.why: Rinsing the nose is sunnah, not fard.
Wiping the neck is not one of the four fard.

questions.q: How many fard of wudu are there?
What happens if we leave out a fard of wudu?
Which surah tells us about wudu?

practice.title: Learn it
prompts: 📖 Learn what Allah said about wudu in Al-Ma’idah 5:6.
